question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0da37c7904f3ef2cec592895f564d6bd91910f4336c76921714b8c9e20d9db90.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Number is increased by 1 and shifting one step ahead in anticlockwise direction.

Vowels are increasing (A, E, I, O, U).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d95057aece166df176324b549e95589027cec9c64079cefc2b0baf95626fdab2.png]
